title: IIT Kharagpur: overview, contacts and student portals

# IIT Kharagpur: overview, contacts and student portals

Indian Institute of Technology Kharagpur (IIT Kharagpur, IIT KGP), Kharagpur, West Bengal - 721302. About 120 km west of Kolkata and about 5 km from Kharagpur railway station. Motto: 'Excellence in action is Yoga' (योगः कर्मसु कौशलम्).

## Contacts
- Phone: +91-3222-255221 · Fax: +91-3222-255303
- Website contact: contact.iic@iitkgp.ac.in
- Network and Wi-Fi help: helpdesk@cc.iitkgp.ac.in (https://cic.iitkgp.ac.in)
- Dean, Student Affairs: 03222-282038 (32222-82038 from campus lines); deansa@hijli.iitkgp.ac.in
- Security control room (24x7): 03222-281001 · Quick Response Team: 03222-281002, 03222-281003
- Five-digit campus numbers need the prefix 03222-2 from a mobile.

## Student portals
- ERP: https://erp.iitkgp.ac.in
- Student Portal: https://student.iitkgp.ac.in
- Central Library: https://www.iitkgp.ac.in/academics-library
- Halls of residence (HMC): https://hmc.iitkgp.ac.in
- Career Development Centre (placements): https://cdc.iitkgp.ac.in/
- Technology Students' Gymkhana: https://gymkhana.iitkgp.ac.in
- Webmail: https://iitkgpmail.iitkgp.ac.in/
- Degree verification and transcripts: https://erp.iitkgp.ac.in/DupCertReqPortal/auth/welcome.htm
- Campus map: https://www.iitkgp.ac.in/campus-map

title: IIT Kharagpur admissions: UG, PG and PhD routes
content:
# IIT Kharagpur admissions: UG, PG and PhD routes

Admissions hub: https://www.iitkgp.ac.in/navpage/admissions (dates and eligibility are on each linked page).

## Undergraduate
- **JEE (Advanced):** https://www.iitkgp.ac.in/jee-ug. Admission is at first-year level in the Autumn Semester (except the 2-year M.Sc of the joint M.Sc–PhD programmes). JEE (Advanced): https://www.jeeadv.ac.in/; IIT seats are allotted through JoSAA.
- From the **2024 curriculum**, admission is only into **4-year B.Tech/B.S.** programmes, and **branch change after the first year has been abolished** (Student Portal).
- JAM: https://www.iitkgp.ac.in/jam-ug
- Other: ITEP https://www.iitkgp.ac.in/studyprogrammes/view/29 · LLB/LLM https://www.iitkgp.ac.in/llb-llm · JPMM https://www.iitkgp.ac.in/jpmm

## Postgraduate
- GATE: https://www.iitkgp.ac.in/gate
- M.Tech and Master in City Planning: https://www.iitkgp.ac.in/mtech-mcp
- MBA and EMBA (Vinod Gupta School of Management): https://som.iitkgp.ac.in
- MHRM https://www.iitkgp.ac.in/mhrm · PGDBA https://www.iitkgp.ac.in/pgdba · MMST https://www.iitkgp.ac.in/mmst · QIP https://www.iitkgp.ac.in/qip

## PhD
- Rolling PhD admission: https://www.iitkgp.ac.in/rolling-phd-admission
- PhD admission calendar: https://www.iitkgp.ac.in/phd-admission

title: IIT Kharagpur academic calendar, scholarships and student support
content:
# IIT Kharagpur academic calendar, scholarships and student support

The session has two semesters of about 20 weeks each: **Autumn (July–November)** and **Spring (January–April)**, aiming for about 90 working days per semester.

## Calendars (open for dates)
- Session 2026-27: https://www.iitkgp.ac.in/assets/pdf/ACADEMIC_CALENDAR_2026_27.pdf
- Session 2025-26: https://www.iitkgp.ac.in/assets/pdf/AcademicCalendar2025-26.pdf (amendments: https://www.iitkgp.ac.in/assets/pdf/ACADEMIC_CALENDAR_2025_26_Amendment.pdf, https://www.iitkgp.ac.in/assets/pdf/ACADEMIC_CALENDAR_2025_26_Amendment_2.pdf)
- Administrative calendar: https://www.iitkgp.ac.in/assets/pdf/AdministrativeCalendar.pdf
- Holidays: https://www.iitkgp.ac.in/holidays

## Fees
The UG Admission Manual (fee structure): https://student.iitkgp.ac.in/docs/UGAdmManual2024.pdf

## Scholarships (Student Portal)
- **Merit-cum-Means (MCM):** about **25%** of each admitted batch, with a further **10%** getting tuition-fee exemption.
- Renewal needs a minimum **GPA of 7.00** each year. Rules: https://www.iitkgp.ac.in/scholarships

## Support
- Dean, Student Affairs: 03222-282038; deansa@hijli.iitkgp.ac.in
- B.C. Roy Technology Hospital: 03222-282632 · Duty Officer (mobile): 9474984524
- Quick Response Team: 03222-281002 / 281003 · Security control room: 03222-281001
- Counselling centre: ask via the Student Portal (https://student.iitkgp.ac.in) or the main line +91-3222-255221.
